title: Owner Auto Policy Tariff Schedule — Certificate-Form Charge on Reinstatement with Lapse
content:
**Owner Auto Policy — certificate-form charge on a reinstatement with lapse.** The charge is added to the reinstatement fee according to the form of the certificate backed by the term. The certificate is a Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) filing, read as it stood on the reinstatement effective date, and selected as follows:
- the certificate entered first with status filed, when its filed date is on or before the reinstatement effective date;
- otherwise, the certificate entered first with status cancellation filed, when its filed date is on or before that date.

A certificate filed after the reinstatement effective date does not change the reading.

| Form of that certificate | Charge added |
|---|---|
| FR-44 | 10.00 |
| SR-22 | 5.00 |
| No such certificate | nothing |

**Notes.**
- The certificate form is the form recorded for the filing, SR-22 or FR-44.
- A term with no such certificate on the reinstatement effective date adds nothing.
- Hypothetical: a term whose only backing certificate is an FR-44 with status cancellation filed, filed before the reinstatement effective date, adds 10.00. An SR-22 first filed after that date does not count.
